keyTagSteps.addLeftRoundEndBody: Add a solid Cylinder and place half of it over the left end of the box.
keyTagSteps.alignHoleBody: Select the hole and the locked left circle. Press Align and choose the middle on both horizontal axes.
keyTagSteps.buildKeyTagBody: Set Snap Grid to 0.5 mm, then build the Key Tag from simple shapes.
keyTagSteps.createHoleBody: Add another Cylinder, set its size, then change it from Solid to Hole.
keyTagSteps.groupKeyTagBody: Select the box, both solid circles, and the hole. Press Group.
keyTagSteps.lockLeftCircleBody: Select the left solid cylinder and press Lock. It will be the alignment reference.
keyTagSteps.makeMiddleBody: Add a Box, then set its size in the shape panel.
keyTagSteps.makeOtherEndBody: Duplicate the solid cylinder and place the copy on the right end.
keyTagSteps.unlockCircleBody: Select the left solid circle again and press Unlock.

nameplateSteps.addTextObjectBody: Open Shapes and add Text. The new object starts with the letter T.
nameplateSteps.buildNameplateBody: Create a rounded base, personalize a Text object, then combine both parts into one printable design.
nameplateSteps.centerNameBody: Lock the base, select the Text and base, then Align to the middle on both horizontal axes. Unlock the base afterward.
nameplateSteps.centerNameCallout: The locked base stays fixed as your alignment reference.
nameplateSteps.groupNameplateBody: Select the base and Text object, then press Group to make one finished printable model.
nameplateSteps.makeBaseBody: Add a Box and enter these dimensions in the shape panel.
nameplateSteps.personalizeTextBody: Change the Text field to your name. This example uses ALEX. Pick any font you like.
nameplateSteps.placeOnTopBody: Lift the Text object until its bottom sits exactly on the top face of the 3 mm base.
nameplateSteps.roundOutsideBody: Select the base, press Fillet, select its outside edges, and apply the treatment.
